description: Create a bounded, source-attributed evidence package for a Macedonian Stock Exchange issuer. Resolves Cyrillic/Latin names and ticker, filters stored filings, news, FinPortal editorial, public stories, and active public document metadata by date range, and groups results by source. Use for company research; this is not live market data, investment advice, or a completeness guarantee.
name: get_company_intelligence
title: Компанија: извори и вести
